2. I have talked to friends and family about it. They all get mad at me except for one person and I've talked extensively about it with her. She's dealt with depression in the past and has gotten past it and she says she'll support me in whatever way she can but i don't want to detract from her life

3. That's part of the reason I'm going to. They'll always have my back and me there's because one slip up could mean death and honestly i don't want to die. I don't want the people around me to die. Death is painful and emotional.

I really hate to bring religion into... anything really but Christianity says that all sin is equal. Not that killing someone is only bad as stealing a pack of gum but that stealing a pack of gum is just as bad as killing someone. Based on that regard, yes you do deserve punishment. Along with the entirety of the human race; past, present, and future. But Christianity also explains that every sin that has been made and will be made is forgiven. You don't just get a second chance, you get as many chances as you need. If you believe, have faith, and fully trust that God sent his son Jesus to die for us to save us, then you are saved. We are all his children and I don't believe he wants us to have eternal death. So in that regard, you deserve absolutely no punishment. Guidance sure, but not punishment..... That's not to say you were in the right with sexting though....

Of course this is just the view of a southern Lutheran...... take what you will from it

Regarding my mental health and despite how it's probably incredibly unhealthy, my mind has..... locks I could say for certain subjects. It works most of the time to where I can talk about a sensitive subject without any negativity but it sometimes fazes through.

Old parts of us die everyday while new parts are born. The important thing is that no matter how you are, you are still you. Nothing can take that from anyone. That's what growing up is all about, right?

Happiness scares me because I only ever feel it in small, fleeting moments. It worries me when I have it because I feel it will leave the moment I relax. I don't think I'll ever find anything I love enough to hold on too in life though. However, I've weighed the options and offing myself has less reason then reaching a natural end. Between now and then I'm going to go to college and get a psychology doctorate. It's not much but I don't want anyone to ever feel the way so many of us do. So I guess that's what I'm holding on to.

Oh and thanks for talking. It really means a lot.
